summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, strong advocate for open source software, passionate about web standards and interoperability, critical of DRM and vendor lock-in practices, active in discussions about privacy and digital rights, interested in mobile Linux projects (Mer, Nemo Mobile), supports decentralized social networks (Diaspora), engaged in discussions about software patents and their impact on innovation, critical of major tech companies' monopolistic practices, prefers Firefox over Chrome for its customizability, emphasizes the importance of user privacy and freedom in technology.
